category_title: Middle school students with diverse learning disorders and low reading engagement
scenario_title: Group work for Greek Mythology unit
minimal_context: The student is working in a group to debate Greek gods and goddesses and create a storyboard for a play.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get with your group. You need to debate about the Greek gods and goddesses, decide what attribute belonged to which god, and discuss what these gods and goddesses would really say in certain situations.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits away from the peers, appearing typically withdrawn) I can't organize my thoughts or information for this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to talk to your group. It is part of the delicate process of creating a play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes disruptive in class, struggling with the social situation) I don't want to talk to them. I have no motivation to do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the storyboard with detailed pictures of each scene and try your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the mask and jewelry away, showing a complete lack of self-control and remaining withdrawn) No! I'm not doing it!
